title: Private prompt execution test
boundary: This is a separate execution that sends data to an external model and may incur charges. It does not select, promote or publish a revision. Private access controls are not an Agent, CLI or filesystem sandbox.
profile: Supported profile only: built-in Claude CLI bare mode with an explicitly configured, fixed-version company-vault API key, legacy/local/fresh execution; no Paperclip token, runtime tools, MCP or bridge. Subscription login, overrides, ACP/native, remote and resumed sessions are unsupported; there is no fallback.
contextBoundary: The preparation ticket binds the fixed Agent configuration, revision and dataset case to an approval digest. Derived execution configuration has a hash witness only; this is not a complete capture or prior approval of all hidden model context.
confirmProfile: I approve the restricted API-key profile without Paperclip tools. This does not authorize switching a subscription account to API billing.
confirmExecution: I separately authorize one real execution of this prepared ticket and its fixed approval digest.
confirmCharges: I understand that this sends data to an external model and may incur charges.
order: Pages use UUID order, not chronology. Refresh to read the latest recorded state.
disabled: Execution is disabled or this profile is unavailable. An operator must enable the server execution gate and configure a supported Agent profile; this page never enables it automatically.
readFailed: Private data is hidden because this read failed or administrator access expired. Refresh after restoring access.
saved: A verified operation receipt was recorded. Pending execution remains locked to this ticket until a matching terminal state. No new execution is started automatically.
unknown: The operation outcome is uncertain. This tab retains only non-secret identity metadata, not prompt text, credentials or results. Refresh revalidates access and binding; it never posts automatically. Awaiting confirmation cannot rule out a delayed Execute: retry only this same ID or atomically cancel it. Closing the tab is not covered.
conflict: The head or request binding changed. Review current registry state and all references before confirming again.
rejected: The server rejected this request. Verify the enabled profile, permissions and fixed references before confirming again.
preparedBoundary: Prepared records a hash of the final prompt. It does not prove process spawn, stdin delivery or provider consumption.
spawnedBoundary: A process spawn was recorded. This is not proof that the provider consumed the prompt.
completedBoundary: Completed means this adapter execution ended with a usable result. It does not prove correctness, provider consumption or publication approval.
resultBoundary: Private, bounded adapter result only. Full stdout/stderr and complete model context are not available. Text is displayed inertly.
resultUnavailable: No complete private result is available for this state. Unknown or failed execution must not be retried automatically.
textOnlyBoundary: Text-only prompt experiment: requires a complete, non-empty SKILL.md and explicitly UTF-8, non-executable text snapshots; skill scripts, tools, binaries and assets are not executed. Only case input is sent, never the expected answer. The literal revision, fixed skill text and case input together must not exceed 256000 UTF-8 bytes; oversized input is rejected, not truncated.
twoPhase: First prepare a metadata-only ticket with a fixed approval digest: preparation never executes or charges a model. Review the returned binding, then separately authorize Execute or atomically cancel the ticket.
ticketReady: Ticket prepared without execution. Review its fixed references and approval digest before separately confirming Execute.
storageFailed: This tab cannot reliably retain the pending operation marker. No execution request will be sent. Restore session storage, then refresh; do not delete an unresolved marker.
snapshotTitle: Server-saved approval snapshot — not current Agent settings
snapshotTarget: Configured working directory (not the final execution directory)
snapshotEnvironment: Target driver / selection source / environment ID
snapshotCredential: Pinned company secret reference / version (not its value)
snapshotRestrictions: This saved profile requires a fresh session, disables tools and Paperclip credentials, and does not capture complete context. It does not authorize later Agent configuration changes.
snapshotUnavailable: This historical record has no validated approval snapshot. It is read-only; execution cannot be authorized.
snapshotCwdUnresolved: Resolved at runtime — not determined yet
